title: kbjob.py serve --kind server keeps one clone per integration remote and runs the jobs placed on the server there, landings from the pushed worker branch
goal: kbjob.py serve --kind server --data DIR takes the queued jobs placed on server, keeps one clone per integration remote url under DIR (cloned at the first job, fetched before each), runs the job's argv there as the CLI would on a workstation and lands an item from the remote work/<id> in a worktree of that clone; a test-ceiling refusal ends the job failed with the reason host condition and the central host's platform, never retried with another ceiling

run:
import sys,os,json,time,tempfile,subprocess,threading,http.server
class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    seen=[]; out={}
    def do_POST(s):
        n=int(s.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0); H.seen.append((s.path,json.loads(s.rfile.read(n) or b"{}")))
        b=json.dumps(H.out).encode(); s.send_response(200); s.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(b))); s.end_headers(); s.wfile.write(b)
    def log_message(s,*a): pass
srv=http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",0),H); threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever,daemon=True).start()
OPA=f"http://127.0.0.1:{srv.server_port}"
dec=lambda **k: {"result":dict({"executor":"workstation","identity":"none","fallback":None,"fallback_after_s":0,"budget_cap_usd":None,"decided_by":"default"},**k)}
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); env=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(d,"c.sqlite"))
kj=lambda *x,e=None: subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbjob.py",*x],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300,env=e or env)
o=os.path.join(d,"o.git"); subprocess.run(["git","clone","-q","--bare","--local",".",o],check=True)
H.out=dec(executor="server")
j1=json.loads(kj("submit","check","--name","backlog-check","--no-ensure","--opa",OPA,"--clone-url","file://"+o).stdout)["job"]
r=kj("serve","--kind","server","--remote","file://"+o,"--data",os.path.join(d,"srv"),"--once")
j2=json.loads(kj("submit","check","--name","tests-changed","--no-ensure","--opa",OPA,"--clone-url","file://"+o).stdout)["job"]
kj("serve","--kind","server","--remote","file://"+o,"--data",os.path.join(d,"srv"),"--once")
s=[json.loads(kj("status",j).stdout)["state"] for j in (j1,j2)]
assert all(x in ("succeeded","failed") for x in s) and len(os.listdir(os.path.join(d,"srv")))==1, (s,r.stderr)

import sys,os,json,tempfile,subprocess,threading,http.server,pathlib
class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_POST(s):
        n=int(s.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0); s.rfile.read(n)
        b=json.dumps({"result":{"executor":"server","identity":"none","fallback":None,"fallback_after_s":0,"budget_cap_usd":None,"decided_by":"default"}}).encode(); s.send_response(200); s.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(b))); s.end_headers(); s.wfile.write(b)
    def log_message(s,*a): pass
srv=http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",0),H); threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever,daemon=True).start()
OPA=f"http://127.0.0.1:{srv.server_port}"
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); env=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(d,"c.sqlite"))
kj=lambda *x: subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbjob.py",*x],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300,env=env)
git=lambda *x,cwd=d: subprocess.run(["git","-c","user.name=t","-c","user.email=t@example.com",*x],cwd=cwd,check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
src=os.path.join(d,"src"); os.makedirs(os.path.join(src,"_tools")); git("init","-q","-b","main",src)
pathlib.Path(src,"_tools","backlog.py").write_text("import os\nprint(os.getcwd(), os.path.isdir(\".claude/worktrees/agent-ST-vst4vom3\"))\n")
pathlib.Path(src,"_tools","tests.py").write_text("import sys\nprint(\"tests.py: over the ceiling: the full run took 99 s, the ceiling is 60 s on \" + sys.platform, file=sys.stderr)\nsys.exit(1)\n")
git("add","-A",cwd=src); git("commit","-q","-m","x",cwd=src); git("branch","work/ST-vst4vom3",cwd=src)
o=os.path.join(d,"o.git"); git("clone","-q","--bare",src,o)
w=os.path.join(d,"ssh.sh"); pathlib.Path(w).write_text("#!/bin/sh\nPATH=\"$(git --exec-path):$PATH\"\nshift\nexec sh -c \"$1\"\n"); os.chmod(w,0o755)
env.update(GIT_SSH=w,GIT_SSH_VARIANT="simple"); U="ssh://localhost"+o
sub=lambda *a: json.loads(kj("submit",*a,"--no-ensure","--opa",OPA,"--clone-url",U).stdout)["job"]
jc=sub("check","--name","tests-changed"); jl=sub("land","ST-vst4vom3")
r=kj("serve","--kind","server","--remote",U,"--data",os.path.join(d,"srv"),"--once")
st=json.loads(kj("status",jc).stdout); sl=json.loads(kj("status",jl).stdout)
ran=[e["fields"]["state"] for e in st["events"]].count("running")
assert (st["state"],st["reason"],st["platform"],ran)==("failed","host condition",sys.platform,1), (st,r.stdout,r.stderr)
assert sl["state"]=="succeeded" and kj("log",jl).stdout.split()[-1]=="True" and len(os.listdir(os.path.join(d,"srv")))==1, (sl,r.stdout)

a server reads the url from the submitting clone's path only

gates.answer: submit takes --clone-url URL, and records remote on a job a server may run, this clone's url when none is given

gates.question: Where does a server executor keep its mirror store and its clones under --data DIR?
options: one directory DIR/server-<8 hex> holding the mirror store and clones/<12 hex of the url>
the mirror store and a clones directory side by side in DIR
gates.recommendation: one directory DIR/server-<8 hex> holding the mirror store and clones/<12 hex of the url>
gates.answer: one directory DIR/server-<8 hex> holding the mirror store and clones/<12 hex of the url>

gates.question: Where does a server run a land job's command, and from what code?

inside the worktree of the work branch, so the code under test runs the landing

gates.answer: in the clone's own tree on the integration main, with a worker worktree of the remote work branch made beside it, as a workstation has

gates.question: Which output ends a job failed as a host condition, and where is it kept?
options: only the seconds line of the test run's refusal; the reason and platform are members of the job record, shown by status
any refusal line of the test run, counts of ids and files too
gates.recommendation: only the seconds line of the test run's refusal; the reason and platform are members of the job record, shown by status
gates.answer: only the seconds line of the test run's refusal; the reason and platform are members of the job record, shown by status

options: one job at a time per url, whatever the operation; other urls run in parallel
jobs of one url run in parallel, each moving the tree as it starts
gates.recommendation: one job at a time per url, whatever the operation; other urls run in parallel
gates.answer: one job at a time per url, whatever the operation; other urls run in parallel
